ActorTalk: (Is that... the legendary Affection meter?)
Why are you... staring at me like that?
I knew it. It really does change.
Why are you suddenly getting so close?!
(Pat Lee's head)
(Hold Lee's hand)
You think you can just touch me and get away?
If you're going to do something, do it right. Don't start and then bail halfway.
I just thought you might not like it.
That doesn't matter. As long as you like it, that's enough.
Next time, just say so.
I won't turn you down.
Do you like it, Lee?
That's something I should be asking you.
Then...
(Gently pinch Lee's cheek)
(Pull your hand back and step away)
So this is some kind of patience test now.
Or maybe you're trying out a new trick. Go on, what's next?
Is that permission to keep going?
Do what you want. Just remember, I'll return the favor later, with interest.
That's enough. Stop backing away already.
I just wanted to give you some space.
No need. Does it really make you feel better to stay away from me?
I never said I minded you being close. Rather, it's the distance that bothers me.
Go on, what do you want to do next? I still don't understand why you enjoy this so much, but that's fine.
How do you even know what I'm thinking, Lee?
Don't be ridiculous, I wasn't enjoying it.
The number above your head keeps going up. It gives you away.
Wait, I have one too?
Oh, so you can see mine too, huh? No wonder you were acting that way.
I was just curious, that's all...
Next time, just ask. I won't hide anything from you.
But that little stunt just now—I should probably return the favor.
That wasn't a stunt!
Doesn't matter. What's important is that you fix the numbers you just lost.
Get ready. You're not leaving until it hits 100%.
